evidence: Swap test fails: a seed library, toy library or equipment-hire desk could take find, basket, confirm and done unchanged with words swapped; surviving elements are the pale ground, white bordered cards, one dark-green filled button, a single sans, a line-icon wordmark. Only the copy (deposit, sessions, 'Open' day tags) is bound to this product.

Category-guess fails: the predicted default for a community/volunteer booking flow (pale neutral ground, forest-green accent, white bordered cards in a 2-up grid, thumbnail + title + meta + availability badge, GOV.UK-like form stack) matches every identity-carrying element on find (items-ladder-3m/default/1280-light.png).

Similar-prompt fails: a brief for a library-of-things in another town, or a community-garden plot booking, would plausibly land on the same frame: green primary, wrench/leaf glyph wordmark, uniform placeholder thumbnails, calendar grid with session tags.

Closest thing to a product-bound device is the pick-up calendar with 'Open' tags / green dots on session days (tool default and day-chosen screens); it carries the session mechanism but is drawn as a stock date grid and does not reach the first viewport of find.
Every tool thumbnail is the same wrench glyph on a pale green tile (find, all widths/themes), so no imagery belongs to this library's stock.

Tool titles truncated with ellipsis at 375 ('Cordless drill 18 V, co...' twice), so the two drill cards look identical (items-ladder-3m/default/375-light).
Headings differ from body mainly by size and weight in the same face; no focal point on find other than the H1 and the green Search button.
Fixed reserve bar crosses the calendar mid-grid in the captures at 1280 and 375, with the button hard against the right edge rather than the 1120px content column (tool default/added 1280-light).
evidence: First viewport of find (1280-light): H1 'Find a tool', grey intro paragraph, full-width empty search field, green Search button, then a 2-up grid of identical-looking white cards. Clean and orderly, nothing to look at beyond text.

Dark theme (filters-open 1280-dark) is composed rather than inverted (cards lighter than ground, mint primary), which is cared for, but the available badge loses its fill in dark while unavailable badges keep a grey pill, so the strongest state reads as weaker.
Done page (1280-light): 'Reservation confirmed' as a plain H1 over a definition list; no moment marking the completed reservation; 'Basket (1)' still in the nav.
Mobile find (375-light): ten stacked cards before the search field, which sits below the whole list; one scroll shows only more identical wrench tiles.
